verdict.rationale: React's own documented capabilities run without a browser: it renders on the server under Node, streams HTML server-side, and runs React Compiler at build time, where compiler errors fail the build. That supports some headless execution in build/CI pipelines. Nothing in the evidence describes running React in CI or in automation workflows specifically. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation documentation, headless test-rendering guidance, any independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
